scope: Runtime source/focused test over the same candidate-bound GLB
binding: Runtime reads the raw GLB from the candidate-bound artifact_sha256 after ArtifactReadback@2 admission

curvature.summary: mean/max absolute adjacent-face dihedral and curved-triangle count

feature_line.summary: boundary edges plus crease edges above the fixed 30-degree threshold

cadfit_residual.optional_source_visual_surface_sha256: when present, must equal Critic surface_signal_canonical_sha256

limitations: This is a bounded mesh-derived surface signal backend, not SubD/NURBS principal curvature, zebra analysis, or a surface reconstruction solver.
It reports typed summaries rather than a quality score and cannot set quality_hard_gate_passed, create candidates/versions, or write CAS/SQLite.
Visual likeness, PBR likeness, human review, packaged UI, export/restart hash, and 360 gates remain independent.
commands: script/with_rust_toolchain.sh cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p forgecad-runtime --lib visual_surface --offline
